extension.description: Automatically track movies and TV shows you watch in Kodi on your WeTrakr profile. Marks content as watched, syncs your viewing activity in real-time.
extension.news:
v1.3.3 - Login: waits for the network after Kodi starts and retries on its own, instead of showing "Could not connect to server". New Connect button in Settings > General. - Fix: a rejected token could reopen the login every 30 seconds while WeTrakr was unreachable.
v1.3.2 - Next Episodes widget: your WeTrakr Next Episodes (including what you watched in other apps) as a skin widget, from Video add-ons > WeTrakr Scrobbler. Episodes in the library play the local file; the others open with TMDb Helper. Settings > Widgets.
v1.3.1 - Your WeTrakr lists in Kodi: pick lists in wetrakr.com > Settings > Kodi and the movies and shows you have get a 'WeTrakr: list name' tag, with a smart playlist in Videos > Playlists for skin widgets. Plan to Watch gets its playlist too. - Fix: a library clean or re-scan could make a new item inherit the sync state of an old one.
